Title: Blurry night vision and dry, gritty eyes? 3 everyday habits hurting your eyes

Description:
If your night vision is getting blurry and glare-heavy and your eyes feel dry and gritty by the end of the day, it might not just be "getting older" - a few everyday habits could be part of the problem.

Soda, fried and processed food, and late-night phone scrolling all quietly add oxidative stress and dryness to your eyes over time. Watch to find out why, and what to swap in instead.
